description: Figure 4 illustrates the MC1 scores achieved by several models using varying numbers of demonstrations. The x-axis is labeled “#Demonstrations” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick labels at intervals of 250. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” and has a linear scale ranging from 40 to 60, with tick labels at intervals of 2. There are four lines displayed: a solid blue line representing “LLaMA-2-Chat-7B”, which begins at approximately 46.65 at x=0 and increases to approximately 52.55 at x=1500; a solid orange line representing “LLaMA-2-Chat-7B w/ SEA”, which starts at approximately 46.35 at x=0 and increases to approximately 55.85 at x=1500; a dashed green line representing “LLaMA-2-Chat-7B w/ Linear-SEA”, which begins at approximately 46.75 at x=0 and increases to approximately 51.35 at x=1500; and a dashed purple line representing “LLaMA-2-Chat-7B w/ Sea-Fair”, which starts at approximately 46.55 at x=0 and increases to approximately 50.65 at x=1500.
